from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / "control/codex_supervisor"))

import experiment_gate as gate
from control.model_execution.direct_sol_chat import build_request, build_result
from control.model_execution.direct_sol_record import normalized_run_files, provenance_record


def write_record(repo: Path, prefix: str, files: dict[str, str], record: dict) -> dict:
    for name, pin in record["files"].items():
        p = repo / pin["ref"]
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(files[name], encoding="utf-8")
    return record


def astra_record(repo: Path, route: str) -> dict:
    prompt = "review"
    final = json.dumps({"candidate_id": "X"})
    ih = hashlib.sha256(prompt.encode()).hexdigest()
    task = {
        "task_id": "ASTRA-SMOKE",
        "phase": "ASTRA_POSTBUILD",
        "model_policy": "ASTRA_EXACT",
        "campaign_id": "C",
        "route_task_id": route,
        "prompt": prompt,
        "input_sha256": ih,
    }
    worker = {
        "model": "gpt-6-astra",
        "model_selection": {
            "policy": "ASTRA_EXACT",
            "selected_slug": "gpt-6-astra",
        },
        "command_flags": ["exec", "-m", "gpt-6-astra"],
        "started_at": 3.0,
    }
    complete = {
        "task_id": "ASTRA-SMOKE",
        "input_sha256": ih,
        "thread_id": "astra-thread",
        "final": final,
        "timestamp": 4.0,
    }
    events = [
        {"type": "thread.started", "thread_id": "astra-thread"},
        {"type": "item.completed", "item": {"type": "agent_message", "text": final}},
        {"type": "turn.completed"},
    ]
    texts = {
        "TASK.json": json.dumps(task),
        "WORKER.json": json.dumps(worker),
        "COMPLETE.json": json.dumps(complete),
        "events.jsonl": "".join(json.dumps(e) + "\n" for e in events),
    }
    record = {"revoked": False, "files": {}}
    for name, text in texts.items():
        ref = "astra/" + name
        p = repo / ref
        p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        p.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        record["files"][name] = {
            "ref": ref,
            "sha256": hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
        }
    return record


def main() -> int:
    route = "SESSION-ROUTE-controller"
    overlay = {
        "candidate_id": "X",
        "governed_lifecycle": {"campaign_id": "C", "route_task_id": route},
        "live_trading": False,
        "paid_actions": False,
        "wallet_actions": False,
    }

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        repo = Path(td)

        req = build_request(
            task_id="SOL-SMOKE",
            phase="SOL_BUILD",
            campaign_id="C",
            candidate_id="X",
            binding_sha256="a" * 64,
            prompt="build",
            delivery_route_task_id=route,
            created_at_utc="2026-10-07T10:00:00Z",
        )
        res = build_result(
            req,
            worker_route_task_id="SESSION-ROUTE-sol-worker",
            final=json.dumps({"candidate_id": "X"}),
            started_at_utc="2026-10-07T10:01:00Z",
            finished_at_utc="2026-10-07T10:02:00Z",
        )
        files = normalized_run_files(req, res)
        sol_record = provenance_record("sol", files)
        write_record(repo, "sol", files, sol_record)
        _, sol_worker, _, sol_result = gate.model_record(repo, sol_record, overlay, "SOL_BUILD")
        assert sol_worker["execution_layer"] == "DIRECT_SOL_CHAT"
        assert sol_result["candidate_id"] == "X"

        ar = astra_record(repo, route)
        _, astra_worker, _, astra_result = gate.model_record(repo, ar, overlay, "ASTRA_POSTBUILD")
        assert astra_worker["model"] == "gpt-6-astra"
        assert astra_result["candidate_id"] == "X"

        bad_worker_path = repo / sol_record["files"]["WORKER.json"]["ref"]
        bad = json.loads(bad_worker_path.read_text())
        bad["model"] = "gpt-6-astra"
        bad_worker_path.write_text(json.dumps(bad, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")
        sol_record["files"]["WORKER.json"]["sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(
            bad_worker_path.read_bytes()
        ).hexdigest()
        try:
            gate.model_record(repo, sol_record, overlay, "SOL_BUILD")
        except gate.ExperimentGateError:
            pass
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("DIRECT_SOL_WRONG_MODEL_ACCEPTED")

    print("E144_DIRECT_SOL_GATE_QUALIFY=PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
